pages.title: Einstein-Rosen Core
pages.text: Both mouths of a bridge between a black hole and a white hole, held together in one object. Einstein and Rosen found that black hole solutions connect two regions of spacetime. The core pulls in at one end and pushes out at the other.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Inside a black hole, I found tidal scrap; inside a white hole, primordial ejecta. Joining them in the Tesseract Assembler with retrocausal crystal and a frozen photon, I built the bridge.
